$comment: PLAT-838 M2 corpus, grown for the v3 re-measurement. EVERY label in this file is AGENT-LABELLED, not human ground truth: one agent read each statement, applied the EARS pattern definitions and recorded its reading, with a second defensible reading in `has_defect_contested` where one exists. Fixtures EARS-FIX-001..016 are the original synthetic set and are unchanged, so the v3 numbers measured against them remain comparable. EARS-FIX-017.. carry `provenance`: `real` rows are verbatim statements from the agent-ix spec trees under ~/dev (repo, path and commit recorded per row, and each was checked to appear verbatim in that file at that commit before this corpus was written); `synthetic` rows were authored for this evaluation to cover defect kinds the four real spec trees supplied no instance of. The defect/clean ratio is held near the original 5/16 so that the constant-predictor baseline MP-222 measures against does not move merely because defects were added. `engine_naive_pattern` is the mechanical keyword derivation, never Jev's answer.

fixtures.statement_text: When the user submits the login form, the system SHALL authenticate the credentials within 2 seconds.
fixtures.engine_naive_pattern_method: mechanical: When -> event_driven

labels.note: Sound event pattern, concrete threshold (2 seconds).

fixtures.provenance_note: Authored for this evaluation; not drawn from a real spec tree.

fixtures.statement_text: When the system is under heavy load, the system SHALL degrade gracefully by disabling non-critical background jobs.

fixtures.provenance_note: Authored for this evaluation; not drawn from a real spec tree.

fixtures.provenance_note: Authored for this evaluation; not drawn from a real spec tree.
